title: India InsurTech funding stagnates at $120 million in 2025; 69% flows into distribution: Report
summary: India's InsurTech sector is witnessing a shift towards artificial intelligence (AI)-led insurance solutions, but funding continues to remain concentrated in distribution-focused businesses, highlighting a gap in investments across underwriting, claims management and other parts of the insurance value chain, according to a recent report by Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and the India InsurTech Association (IIA).

direction_reasons: TECHNOLOGY cuts both ways — growth against capital, cost or execution risk
